phase: Phase 2 development; all graph families examined previously
primary_estimand: Within-family high-minus-sham focal binary-role-accuracy penalty for ordered_roles minus participant_only at final 6000-update checkpoint, first scene suite; average seeds within family then eight families equally.
statistics: Report family effects, mean, 95% t interval, exact two-sided family sign-flip p as descriptive development evidence; no independent-confirmation claim.
performance_match: Select one arm-wide checkpoint from 1500/3000/4500/6000 minimizing difference to ordered_roles final average on eight preselected nonfocal unseen pairs per cell, requiring >=95% familiar accuracy in every cell. Valid match requires <=2 percentage-point gap. Focal outcomes do not select checkpoints.
ceiling: Flag an arm/family when focal role accuracy >=97% in both conditions; a flat penalty at ceiling is not structural robustness.
guardrail: Report familiar four-choice and focal event accuracy, no outcome-based exclusions. Technical reruns only at identical configuration.
interpretation: The rewire is a multi-property package. Role-swap arm is global identity-equivariance and cannot by itself establish correct role extraction. No pretrained LLM claim.
